fluff.overview: Despite the low regard most Clans hold for conventional infantry, these formations benefit from incidental access to Clan technology that makes even a disaffected garrison Point a match for its Inner Sphere equivalent. Mechanized Wheeled Points use wheeled armored vehicles that balance speed and protection better than hovercraft or motorcycles. Effective on developed road networks and open terrain, they sacrifice the all-terrain capability of tracked vehicles for better sustained speed on firm ground. Equipped with the Clan-manufactured Mauser IIC Infantry Assault System, these warriors carry energy weapons built to Clan standards that outperform their Inner Sphere equivalents in both range and damage output.
